description: Curated relational knowledge graph for Ayurvedic IP, ABS and drug-regulatory reasoning. Every node carries a citation and a verified flag; unverifiable statements are marked verified:false. Edges encode the deterministic relationships the agent traverses.

nodes.label: India
nodes.summary: National Indian IP, biodiversity and drug-regulatory regime.

nodes.label: International
nodes.summary: International treaties and framework; no single global patent.

nodes.label: Classical / generic medicine
nodes.citation: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 (ASU drugs); First Schedule authoritative texts
nodes.summary: Formulation and method drawn from a First-Schedule authoritative Ayurvedic text.

nodes.label: Patent / proprietary medicine
nodes.summary: Contains ingredients from authoritative texts but a proprietary name/combination.

nodes.label: New / non-classical drug
nodes.citation: New Drugs and Clinical Trials Rules, 2019
nodes.summary: Non-classical claim or novel use requiring proof of safety and effectiveness.

nodes.label: Phytopharmaceutical
nodes.citation: Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945 (phytopharmaceutical drug provisions)
nodes.summary: Purified plant fraction with defined constituents; requires characterisation and data.

nodes.label: Ayurveda-Aahar / nutraceutical
nodes.summary: Food product formulated per authoritative Ayurvedic texts; FSSAI-regulated.

nodes.label: Cosmetic
nodes.citation: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940; Cosmetics Rules, 2020
nodes.summary: Applied for cleansing/beautifying without therapeutic disease claims.

nodes.label: Patent
nodes.summary: Protects a novel, non-obvious, industrially-applicable invention.

nodes.label: Geographical Indication
nodes.citation: Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Act, 1999
nodes.summary: Protects goods with a defined geographic origin and reputation.

nodes.label: Trademark
nodes.summary: Protects brand names, logos and marks distinguishing goods.

nodes.label: Design
nodes.summary: Protects novel visual/ornamental features of an article.

nodes.label: Copyright
nodes.summary: Protects original literary/artistic works (labels, manuals), not the formulation.

nodes.label: Plant Variety Protection
nodes.citation: Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers' Rights Act, 2001
nodes.summary: Protects distinct, uniform, stable new plant varieties.

nodes.label: Trade secret
nodes.citation: Protected under common law / contract (no dedicated statute)
nodes.summary: Confidential formulation know-how protected by contract and confidentiality.

nodes.label: Patents Act, 1970 (Rules 2024)
nodes.summary: Primary Indian patent statute and its 2024 procedural rules.

nodes.label: Biological Diversity Act, 2002 (Amd 2023)
nodes.citation: Biological Diversity Act, 2002 as amended 2023; BD Rules 2024
nodes.summary: Governs access to biological resources and benefit sharing.

nodes.label: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940
nodes.summary: Regulates ASU drugs, phytopharmaceuticals and cosmetics.

nodes.label: Drugs and Magic Remedies Act, 1954
nodes.citation: Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954
nodes.summary: Restricts disease/therapeutic advertising claims.

nodes.label: FSSAI Ayurveda Aahar Regulations
nodes.summary: Food-safety regime for Ayurvedic food products.

nodes.label: Section 3(p)
nodes.summary: Traditional knowledge, or an aggregation of known TK properties, is not an invention.

nodes.label: Section 3(d)
nodes.summary: New forms of known substances without enhanced efficacy are not patentable.

nodes.label: Section 10(4) disclosure
nodes.summary: Source and geographic origin of biological material must be disclosed.

nodes.label: TKDL
nodes.citation: Traditional Knowledge Digital Library (IPO prior-art database)
nodes.summary: Documented prior art recognised by the Indian Patent Office.

nodes.label: ABS approval / benefit sharing
nodes.summary: Approval / benefit-sharing where a biological resource is accessed for commercial use.

nodes.label: Source & origin disclosure
nodes.summary: Disclose biological source and geographic origin in the patent specification.

nodes.label: Safety & efficacy data
nodes.citation: New Drugs and Clinical Trials Rules, 2019
nodes.summary: Generate proof of safety and effectiveness for a new/non-classical drug.

nodes.label: GI registration
nodes.summary: Register the good with the GI Registry to obtain protection.

nodes.label: Advertising-claim restrictions
nodes.summary: Do not make prohibited disease/therapeutic advertising claims.

nodes.label: TRIPS Agreement
nodes.summary: Minimum IP standards for WTO members.

nodes.label: Convention on Biological Diversity
nodes.summary: Sovereign rights over biological resources; basis for ABS.

nodes.label: Nagoya Protocol
nodes.citation: Nagoya Protocol on Access and Benefit-sharing
nodes.summary: International ABS framework; applies to parties.

nodes.label: WIPO GRATK Treaty, 2024
nodes.citation: WIPO Treaty on IP, Genetic Resources and Associated TK, 2024
nodes.summary: Introduces a genetic-resource/TK disclosure requirement for members.

nodes.label: Patent Cooperation Treaty
nodes.summary: Unified international patent-application filing procedure.

nodes.label: Madrid System
nodes.summary: International trademark registration system.

nodes.label: Hague System
nodes.summary: International registration of industrial designs.

nodes.label: Budapest Treaty
nodes.summary: International recognition of micro-organism deposits for patent purposes.

edges.note: Classical formulations are traditional knowledge and face the s. 3(p) bar.
Documented in / defensible via TKDL as prior art.
Proprietary name protectable as a trademark.
Licensed as a patent/proprietary ASU medicine.
Combination may still be an aggregation of known TK properties.
Genuine patent potential if novel and non-obvious.
Characterised fraction may support a patent claim.
TKDL match can defeat novelty/inventive step.
